author: devbig030
body: Execution plan after pod-9 review: (1) exercise production parsers with cargo-fuzz targets/corpora for ImageHeader, PodArtifact, BootstrapContext, offsets/layout descriptors; (2) add bounded exhaustive/reference-state models for futex 0/1/2 and closeable admission/SNZI/C-SNZI close-entry-depart interleavings, tied to production encodings where possible; (3) deterministic process fault cuts for initialization, attach/admission, lock owner/waiter, reloc allocator transaction, TargetReady/teardown, and connector failure; (4) Miri on pure offset/layout APIs and nightly ASan/TSan on supported thread-only paths, with a script that reports unavailable/unsupported tools distinctly instead of silently passing; (5) integrate bounded smoke into release-check and document exact evidence limits. Never imply model replicas prove production code unless shared transition helpers are exercised.
